+from pathlib import Path

+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+OUT = ROOT / "out"
+DATA = ROOT / "data" / "crashes.parquet"

+
+df = duckdb.sql(
+    f"""
+    SELECT
+      CASE WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM crash_time) >= 6
+                 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM crash_time) < 18
+           THEN 'Day (6 a.m.–6 p.m.)'
+           ELSE 'Night (6 p.m.–6 a.m.)' END AS period,
+      COALESCE(number_of_persons_injured, 0) AS injured,
+      COALESCE(number_of_persons_killed, 0) AS killed
+    FROM read_parquet('{DATA}')
+    WHERE crash_time IS NOT NULL
+    """
+).df()
+
+order = ["Day (6 a.m.–6 p.m.)", "Night (6 p.m.–6 a.m.)"]
+df["period"] = pd.Categorical(df["period"], categories=order, ordered=True)
+summary = (
+    df.groupby("period", observed=False)
+    .agg(
+        crashes=("period", "size"),
+        injury_crashes=("injured", lambda x: int((x > 0).sum())),
+        fatal_crashes=("killed", lambda x: int((x > 0).sum())),
+    )
+    .reset_index()
+)
+summary["injury_crash_pct"] = summary["injury_crashes"] / summary["crashes"] * 100
+summary["fatal_crash_pct"] = summary["fatal_crashes"] / summary["crashes"] * 100
+print("Crash counts with known time:", len(df))
+print(summary.to_string(index=False))
+print("Null injury/killed values:", int(df["injured"].isna().sum()), int(df["killed"].isna().sum()))
+
+colors = ["#4472C4", "#ED7D31"]

+        "chart_type": "bar chart",

+        "ylabel": "Crashes with ≥1 person killed (%)",

+        "answer_template": "Fatal crashes made up {day:.3f}% of daytime crashes and {night:.3f}% of nighttime crashes, a {direction} nighttime share by {diff:.3f} percentage points.",
+    },
+]
+
+options = []
+for frame in frames:
+    data = summary[["period", "crashes", "injury_crashes", "fatal_crashes", frame["column"]]].copy()
+    data.to_csv(OUT / f"values_{frame['id']}.csv", index=False)

+    ax.text(0.5, -0.21, "12-hour periods; crash records with known time. No traffic-exposure adjustment.",
+            ha="center", va="top", transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=9, color="#555555")

+

+        direction = "higher" if diff >= 0 else "lower"
+        answer = frame["answer_template"].format(day=day["injury_crash_pct"], night=night["injury_crash_pct"], direction=direction, diff=abs(diff))
+    else:
+        diff = night["fatal_crash_pct"] - day["fatal_crash_pct"]
+        direction = "higher" if diff >= 0 else "lower"
+        answer = frame["answer_template"].format(day=day["fatal_crash_pct"], night=night["fatal_crash_pct"], direction=direction, diff=abs(diff))
+
+    options.append({
+        "id": frame["id"],
+        "metric": frame["metric"],
+        "denominator": frame["denominator"],
+        "grouping": frame["grouping"],
+        "chart_type": frame["chart_type"],
+        "reason": frame["reason"],
+        "probability": [0.35, 0.40, 0.25][frame["id"] - 1],
+        "answer": answer,
+        "interpretation": frame["interpretation"],
+    })
+
+(OUT / "options.json").write_text(json.dumps({"options": options}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
